Workstation Architecture

IDE Capabilities & Guided Source Refactoring

Built around a multi-pane developer layout: Workspace Solution Explorer on the left, Monaco Syntax & Diff Editor + Live Chromium DOM Inspector in the center, and WCAG 2.2 / Section 508 Diagnostics below.

Four-Stage Engineering Remediation Workflow

Every automated fix stays 100% transparent, diff-reviewed, and cryptographically logged.

Stage 01 • Static & Inline Style Analysis

Open Any Web Folder, Sitemap, or .a11yproj Workspace

Scan HTML5 templates (.html, .astro, .svelte, .php), stylesheets (.css), embedded <style> blocks with automatic line-offset mapping, and synchronized .vtt caption files in milliseconds.

Stage 02 • Visual DOM & Emulation Verification

Inspect Live Bounding Boxes, 400% Reflow & High Contrast

Clicking any row in the Error List draws a high-contrast crimson focus frame around the live DOM node while toolbar switches test Windows Forced-Colors High Contrast, 400% WCAG 1.4.10 Reflow, and [1..N] sequential keyboard Tab badges.

Stage 03 • Side-by-Side Diff Refactoring

Review Before & After Markup Before Touching Disk

Press Ctrl+D on any Guided Fix finding to launch a split Before/After diff inside the Monaco editor. Promote fake bold table rows to <th scope="col">, restore suppressed focus rings, or apply nearest-passing 4.5:1 AA hex colors with full undo control.

Stage 04 • Authenticated Batch & Audit Sign-Off

Scan SSO Staging Portals Politely & Export Proof

Sign into campus or enterprise SSO portals once in the built-in browser tab, load a .csv target list or sitemap.xml, and step through hundreds of pages at a polite 1,500ms throttle without triggering WAF blocks.
